prompts.special_ocelot_mobility_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production sprite animation sheet for a side-scrolling Metal Gear Solid fan game. Generate a clean 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid, exactly 16 separate full-body poses of ONE AND THE SAME Revolver Ocelot in his original 1998 Metal Gear Solid / Shadow Moses appearance. Layout: square 1536x1536, uniform cyan thin gridlines, plain pure magenta #FF00FF in every cell, no floor or shadows. 20% padding within every cell, entire boots, coat, hands and revolver safely contained. All poses face RIGHT, strict lateral profile, consistent camera, scale and foot baseline near 85% of cell. Crisp detailed pixel-art with realistic adult proportions and restrained PS1-era colors, suited for downsampling to 128px cells. Character identity: older lean white-haired man with slicked-back silver hair tied into a short ponytail and thick white moustache; long brown/tan Western duster coat with split tails, dark charcoal vest and trousers, gray shirt, small red cravat, leather ammunition belt and holster, dark boots, gloves. Carries a single Colt Single Action Army revolver with long barrel, NOT a modern pistol, NOT a rifle, no cowboy hat, no eyepatch, no camouflage, no MGS3 young Ocelot, no MGS2 suit redesign. His exact costume and hair remain the same in all16 cells. ROW1: IDLE four distinct subtle breathing phases, revolver held low and ready. ROW2: RUN four clear progressive stride phases, coat tails respond to movement, whole body visible. ROW3: SHOOT four phases: aim right, trigger/recoil, recover barrel, ready; modest tiny muzzle flash confined insidecell only in firing phase. ROW4: RELOAD four phases: lower revolver, open loading gate with free hand, feed cartridges, return to ready; same recognizable single-action revolver. Exactly one isolated character percell, no duplicates, no other people, no text, letters, numbers, captions, UI, watermark, background scenery. Pose changes must be anatomically authored, not a static figure shifted or rotated. Faithful original fan-made adaptation informed by Konami MGS character archive, not a copy of official sprite or illustration.
